messages:
Maya CSM: Hey all — kicking off the zero-to-live playbook for Pathfinder Labs. They want a 30-day pilot on Dedicated (EU data). Primary goals: validate latency/cost and embedding recall. Quick outline below, please confirm owners and blockers.

Arjun Solutions: I can own integration plan + SDK onboarding. Will pair with Lena for SAML.

Lena (Pathfinder): Confirming SAML + EU-only storage. Initial dataset is ~20M tokens, mostly product docs.

Sam PM: Timeline idea: 
```
Week 0: Kickoff + infra provisioning
Week 1: Integration + test prompts
Week 2: Canary (5 days) + telemetry check
Week 3-4: Evaluate metrics + adjust quantization/batching
```
Canary success metric: P95 < 2s and embedding recall >= 85% for priority queries.

Dmitri Eng: I'll provision Dedicated pool in eu-west-1. Need model pin (suggest gpt-open-3b-v1.2) and target batch config. Also: confirm whether we should enable prefix KV caching for the pilot.

Maya CSM: Dmitri — please set up fallback policy to hosted variants if Dedicated is saturated. Arjun — can you confirm SDK integration ETA?

Arjun Solutions: SDK integration ETA: 3 working days after infra ready. I need API keys and a test dataset. Also will add short integration guide for the client.

Lena (Pathfinder): API keys ok; will share sanitized test set by EOD Friday.

Maya CSM: Success criteria recap for renewal signal: pilot meets latency & recall targets, and unit cost stays within projected bounds (pilot target: <= $0.003/token effective). If we miss latency, renewal risk flagged.

Sam PM: Can we capture qualitative feedback during canary? Short daily survey for engineers + 1 UX session after week 2.

Arjun Solutions: I'll embed a one-question feedback widget in staging.

Dmitri Eng: For quantization, propose q4f16 for generator and fp16 for embeddings. Will monitor regression and revert if needed.

Maya CSM: Outstanding blockers: 
- legal: confirm DPA addendum signed (Lena to confirm)
- infra: quota approval for Dedicated (Ops team)
- security: SAML test account
Please mark owners.

Lena (Pathfinder): DPA status: signed, will attach copy. SAML test user ETA: Monday.

OpsBot: infra-quota: Dedicated GPU quota approved for eu-west-1 (ticket #4478).

Dmitri Eng: Noted. I'll kick off cluster provisioning tomorrow morning.

Maya CSM: Great. Action items — I put owners: Arjun (integration), Dmitri (infra/deploy), Sam (telemetry + canary metrics), Lena (client coordination/legal). Next sync: Wednesday 10am PT. If anything urgent, ping me or drop updates here. :thumbsup:

Lena (Pathfinder): See you Wednesday. Thanks!

Arjun Solutions: I'll post the integration checklist in #devex after infra is live.

Maya CSM: Closing notes — we'll capture the pilot evaluation in Confluence and send a single-slide health report at day 30. Thanks everyone.
